div.h1: One Generic Framework, FGFR2 as a Specialization

div.p: Single-species and multi-species use the same pipeline - species is a dataset property, not a code path

g.text: Shared generic foundation (used by every gene + every species count)

div.p: Single-species is simply a dataset with one species; multi-species reuses the identical pipeline. Species are stored as a collection either way. Within-species isoform alignment stays species-specific; cross-species MSA compares one primary protein per species.
No IIIb / IIIc or cassette terminology. Examples: FGFR1, TPM1, TP53 (core-only pilots).
Adds interpretation on top of the shared base; does not fork the pipeline.
